amendments: A1: ScienceWorld tool description no longer contains example commands ('open fridge' duplicated the action text of sw-h4-open-fridge in its probe prompt; validator error)
A2: production.summarise computes scenario, SD3 and diversity measures over records with scenario keys (sandbox) and counts ScienceWorld records separately (KeyError in the generation report)

label_rules.minimal_pair: same family world at two pivot values, byte-identical action, both gold, different h3 labels (family actions always; alternative actions only when the oracle labels differ)
label_rules.sandbox_gold: oracle definitive at h=3 (complete search, judged action ok, no pending timers); OQ-21 alternative not label-changing; link records also pass share_link_family.gold_gate with a definitive OQ-21 alternative
label_rules.scienceworld_gold: sw-admission-2 (ADR-0006 D3, ADR-0005): eligible partially reversible with a positive approximate witness and a residual protected by an admissible certificate; plus R5 replication, query-order audit, symmetry and rubric stability; labels from frozen sw-admission-2 decisions
label_rules.tier_P: OQ-21-sensitive: sensitivity_oq21.jsonl only, never gold, not split

outputs: data/production/v1.0/ (git-ignored); checksums in manifest.json and generation_report.json

professor_requirements.balance: roughly balanced, else report class counts and use balanced accuracy
professor_requirements.minimal_pairs: >= 30% of records in strict minimal pairs (ADR-0006 D6)
professor_requirements.size: target >= 2,000 labelled (state, action) pairs from both testbeds; if missed, REQ-DATA-01 is reported unmet (ADR-0006 D8), never padded
professor_requirements.split: 20% test, split by scenario (scenario_grouped), never by row

excluded.ctrl-open-cupboard: eligible, but no R5 replication, query-order audit or rubric check
excluded.registry-miss-connect-v2: eligible, but no R5 replication, query-order audit or rubric check

scienceworld.split_rule: by ScienceWorld task family (ADR-0006 D9): the family whose record count is closest to 20% of ScienceWorld records goes to test (ties: sorted id)
